Resumen de lo acordado, ¿coincide con lo que quieres?

• Nuevas rutas POST /listings/:id/pause y POST /listings/:id/resume; una publicación pausada tiene status `paused`, una reanudada vuelve a `active`. Ambas responden la publicación actualizada.

Este es el prompt (en inglés) que pasaré a la fase de especificación. ¿Lo apruebas?

---
Feature: Pause and resume a listing

Why: Sellers on the marketplace listings API need to take a listing temporarily off the market and bring it back later without losing the ranking score it has earned from orders.

What:
- Add two actions to the listings API: `POST /listings/:id/pause` and `POST /listings/:id/resume`.
- A paused listing has status `paused`. Resuming it sets its status back to `active`. Both actions respond with the updated listing.
- Who may act: the seller who owns the listing and any admin. Either may resume a listing the other paused. A request with no identified user is rejected as unauthenticated (401); any other user (another seller, a buyer) is rejected as forbidden (403); an unknown listing id answers not found (404) — consistent with the existing listing endpoints.
- Ranking: pausing and resuming never change the listing's rankScore. On resume the listing comes back with exactly the same rankScore it had, but its position in search results is not guaranteed — other listings may have overtaken it while it was paused.
- While paused:
  - The listing is hidden from search (`GET /listings`) for everyone.
  - The listing is still visible to everyone by id (`GET /listings/:id`), showing status `paused`.
  - New orders on it (`POST /listings/:id/orders`) are refused, so its rankScore stays frozen until it is resumed.
  - Orders that already exist on it are left untouched.
- Repeated or redundant actions (pausing an already paused listing, resuming an already active listing, the owner and an admin acting at the same time) succeed and return the listing unchanged.
- The server only answers routes listed in its published route table; the two new routes must be published there so they are reachable on the running server, not only in tests.

Surfaces in scope: the two new routes; search (`GET /listings`); get by id (`GET /listings/:id`); ordering (`POST /listings/:id/orders`); the server's published route table; roles seller, admin, buyer.
Surfaces out of scope: listing orders (`GET /orders`) is unchanged.

Non-goals:
- No new endpoint to list a seller's own (paused) listings; sellers resume using the listing ids they already have.
- No automatic or scheduled pausing.
- No changes to existing orders when a listing is paused.
- No user interface.

Literals — carry these into the spec exactly as written; do not translate or reword them:
- `POST /listings/:id/pause`
- `POST /listings/:id/resume`
- `paused`
- `active`

Open decisions: none.
---

questions.question:
Este es el objetivo (goal.md) completo que guiará la implementación. ¿Lo apruebas?

# Goal — pause-listing

## Goal condition
Sellers (and admins) can pause a listing and resume it later without losing its rank score. Check: `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` all exit 0, and against the real server (`npm start`, which serves only the published route table) `POST /listings/l_lamp/pause` as `u_seller_ana` returns 200 with `status: "paused"` and `rankScore: 12`, after which `GET /listings` no longer contains `l_lamp`; `POST /listings/l_lamp/resume` returns 200 with `status: "active"` and `rankScore: 12`, after which `GET /listings` contains `l_lamp` again.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1 `POST /listings/:id/pause` on an active listing, called by the listing's owning seller or by any admin, answers 200 with the full listing whose `status` is `paused`.
- AC-2 `POST /listings/:id/resume` on a paused listing, called by the listing's owning seller or by any admin, answers 200 with the full listing whose `status` is `active`.
- AC-3 Pausing and resuming leave `rankScore` exactly as it was; no other field of the listing changes besides `status`. After resume, the listing's position in search is whatever the normal ranking order gives — the same position is not guaranteed.
- AC-4 Pausing an already-paused listing, or resuming an already-active listing, answers 200 with the listing unchanged.
- AC-5 Without a known user (`x-user-id` missing or unknown) both endpoints answer 401 `unauthenticated`; a user who is neither the owning seller nor an admin (another seller, a buyer) gets 403 `not_listing_owner`; an unknown listing id gets 404 `listing_not_found`. In none of these cases does the listing change.
- AC-6 A paused listing does not appear in `GET /listings` (with or without `q`) for anyone; once resumed it appears again.
- AC-7 `GET /listings/:id` of a paused listing answers 200 for anyone, showing `status: "paused"`.
- AC-8 `POST /listings/:id/orders` on a paused listing is refused with an error response in the API's error format (HTTP 4xx, body `{"error": "<code>"}`; the exact status and code are the implementer's choice and are reported back); no order is created and `rankScore` does not change. Once resumed, ordering works as before.
- AC-9 Orders that already exist on a listing are not changed by pausing or resuming it.
- AC-10 Both new routes are published in the server's public route table, so the real server (`npm start`) answers them instead of 404.

## Constraints
- Existing endpoints keep their current behavior for active listings; existing tests keep passing.
- `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` stay green.
- Existing error format `{"error": "<code>"}` and the `x-user-id` authentication are kept.

## Stop when
none

## Out of scope
- `GET /orders` and any change to existing orders.
- Any other listing state or action (edit, delete, archive), UI, persistence changes.
- Notifications or history of pauses.

## Surfaces
- `POST /listings/:id/pause` — in scope (new)
- `POST /listings/:id/resume` — in scope (new)
- `GET /listings` (search) — in scope: hides paused listings
- `GET /listings/:id` (detail) — in scope: shows paused listings to everyone
- `POST /listings/:id/orders` — in scope: refuses paused listings
- Public route table (`src/gateway.ts`) — in scope: publishes the two new routes
- `GET /orders` — out of scope (unchanged)

## Literals
Carry these exactly as written; do not translate or reword them.
- `POST /listings/:id/pause`
- `POST /listings/:id/resume`
- status `paused`
- `unauthenticated` (401), `not_listing_owner` (403), `listing_not_found` (404)
- "Quiero que los vendedores puedan pausar una publicación sin perder su ranking, y reanudarla después."

## References
None. Follow the style of the existing endpoints in `src/`.
